notes: Yalu §5.1 — run_de pairwise cell type vs cell type.
final_text: I found the differential expression between CM.1 and Fib.1 based on cell type. A total of 7,067 genes were significant (padj<0.05), with 3,957 genes upregulated in CM.1 and 3,110 genes upregulated in Fib.1. The top genes up in CM.1 include Rbm20 and Fgf13, while Mrc2 and Gpr39 are among the top upregulated genes in Fib.1. Please note that these results are based on the Wilcoxon rank-sum test, which may yield overly significant p-values in single-cell analyses. Would you like to see a volcano plot for these results?

prompt: Find differentially expressed genes between Control and Mutant.
notes: Yalu §5.2 — run_de pairwise condition vs condition.
final_text: I performed pairwise differential expression analysis comparing the Control and Mutant groups based on the 'orig.ident' column. A total of 3,829 genes were found to be significant (adjusted p-value < 0.05), with 640 genes upregulated in Control and 3,189 genes upregulated in Mutant. The top upregulated genes in Control include Gm42743 (log2FC=7.67) and Il1rapl1 (log2FC=5.94), while in Mutant, H2-Ea (log2FC=-26.18) and Gm20110 (log2FC=-4.99) were the most notable. Please note that the Wilcoxon rank-sum test was used for this analysis, and for publication purposes, consider using pseudo-bulk DESeq2 as single-cell tests can yield overly significant p-values when multiple samples per condition are present. Would you like me to generate a volcano plot for these results?
